acceptCallbackWork: Native claims call assert*InputTx before job locks; DXF/KML/OBJ/glTF/GeoParquet also verify tools there.
CityGML and IFC current() verify tools BEFORE opening their guard transaction (citygml-worker.ts:106-108).

DXF:126 dxfNativeEntities reads/parses the artifact INSIDE accept; KML/OBJ/glTF/GeoParquet validators
read receipt/artifact and hash bytes INSIDE accept; CityJSON:91-95 does the same; validation:122 reads reports.
These awaited storage calls can legitimately leave a transaction idle, but its last SQL would normally be
the later attempt SELECT, NOT the first metadata SELECT. None of these non-CityGML model kinds ran in run 5.
Table/raw/profile accepts query their state/closure, then update receipts, queue follow-ups and append events.
Intake-draft accept:409 queries current draft before hashing it; large/intake helpers validate state then settle.
PDF:73 is an additional metadata SELECT inside validateResult, with small input-pin checks before plan queries.

benchmark.pc: Windows x64, Intel Core i7-14700K, 28 logical CPUs, Node v24.19.0
benchmark.method: Exact pure TS function bodies transpiled in memory; no app/config/storage bootstrap or credentials.
benchmark.controls: Construction excluded; GC before each trial; three trials except costly token/full inventory.
benchmark.hypothesis: Long-token redaction or tool inventory, rather than bounded native JSON, can block for seconds.
benchmark.criterion: Redaction >1000 ms and >10x equal-length prose; near-cap native JSON is the bounded control.
benchmark.stop: One comparison; token length <=65536, stop after any token trial >30 s; no tuning on real data.
benchmark.result: Criterion met at 32768 characters; 65536 took 11382.6 ms versus 3.158 ms spaced prose.
benchmark.shapeLimits: Synthetic S/M source examples 1/16 MiB, native output 4.10/15.75 MB; actual run sizes unknown.

proposedFix.smallestSafeScope: Move document-native.ts unit redaction/segmentation/hash/parse to a bounded worker thread.

proposedFix.whyNotMoveTransactionOnly: Already outside its own transaction; it starves other jobs' transactions.

proposedFix.followup: Replace nonlinear email matching with a reviewed linear scanner; test boundary masking.
